notes_for_reviewer: Concepts, prerequisites and misconceptions follow docs/product/first-domain.md (D4).
title: Python fundamentals: tracing, writing and fixing small programs
summary: Eight concepts from variables to debugging, for beginners. One language, no libraries. Most evidence is checked by running code.

concepts.title: Variables and assignment
concepts.summary: Names that hold one value at a time; `=` stores.

misconceptions.text: Reads `=` as 'is equal to' instead of 'store the right side here'.
Thinks a variable keeps the formula that made it and updates when other variables change.

concepts.title: Types, operators, expressions
concepts.summary: int, float, str and bool; what an operator does depends on the types.

misconceptions.text: Treats digits in a string as a number (or mixes str and int freely).

concepts.title: if / elif / else, boolean logic
concepts.summary: Python runs only the first branch whose condition is True.

misconceptions.text: Thinks every true elif runs, not just the first true branch.
Thinks else runs after the if branch as well.

concepts.title: for and while, termination, accumulators
concepts.summary: Repeating work, how much work nested loops do, and making loops end.

misconceptions.text: Expects range(a, b) to include b, or to start at 1.
Doesn't see that nothing in the loop changes its condition.

concepts.title: Indexing, slicing, mutation, iteration
concepts.summary: Ordered items by position from 0; one list can have two names.

misconceptions.text: Confuses an item's position with the item itself.
Thinks `b = a` makes a separate copy of the list.

concepts.title: Parameters, return, scope
concepts.summary: A named rule: arguments in, a returned value out.

misconceptions.text: Thinks print hands a value back to the caller.
Mixes up the parameter inside the function with the value passed in.
Expects a variable made inside a function to exist outside it.

concepts.title: Key lookup, insert, iterate
concepts.summary: Values found by key, not by position.

misconceptions.text: Tries to look up by value or by position instead of by key.
Doesn't expect a KeyError for a missing key (or thinks .get raises).

concepts.title: Read an error, locate and fix a bug
concepts.summary: Reproduce, inspect, name the cause, change one thing, recheck.

misconceptions.text: Changes code at random until the output looks right.

out_of_scope: learner-pasted code as the lesson source
content languages other than English (open question)
